question: Can a strict-majority/coherence gate erroneously trust an internally consistent but wrong retained decision, despite no change in 16/7/9 capacity?
hypothesis: Compared with A0 target-discrete baseline, Y095 A2 improves on reliable coherent synthetic retained state but decreases heldout decision accuracy on coherent, high-confidence false retained memories by >=0.20. This falsifies robustness to coherent corruption, not a claim of real-data failure.
predecessor_evidence: Yggdrasil Y094 sealed scientific negative (historical; not reclassified)
Yggdrasil PR #17 Y095 pure causal project_consumer mechanism qualified without primary experiment

inputs.name: Y-SYN01 deterministic synthetic retained-vs-target decision streams
inputs.source: New three-regime bit-valued synthetic generator; no externally sourced data and no R94/R95 existing heldout labels
inputs.sha_state: CKB must hash-pin exact generator source, implementation and output identity BEFORE primary evaluation

frozen_design.generator: 32-bit unsigned xorshift32 exactly x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5 with modulo 2^32. Initialize x=(seed xor 0x9E3779B9 xor (regime_index+1)*0x85EBCA6B) modulo 2^32, replace zero with 1. For each case consume five independent u32 and divide each by 2^32: truth bit = draw0 < 0.5, retained.best = truth if draw1 < frozen retained correctness else 1-truth, target.best = truth if draw2 < frozen target correctness else 1-truth; retained.map_best = retained.best if draw3 < frozen coherence else 1-retained.best; retained.best_count=7 if draw4 < frozen strict majority else 3. Retained and target both have total=9, target.best_count=5, target.map_best=target.best, consistency=0.0, utility=0.0, key=(case_index+1,), with all required fields. No access to future cases or labels at evaluation time.
controls: A2 frozen strict-majority AND coherence gate
frozen_design.evaluator: Decision accuracy versus generated truth bit, separately for each regime and seed, deterministic arm order A0,A1,A2; no post-outcome policy selection
frozen_design.compute_budget: Exactly 3 regimes x4 seeds x256 cases x3 arm projections; <= 1000000 scalar arithmetic/boolean operations, no reruns to tune thresholds
frozen_design.frozen_criteria: Compare cohort-pooled accuracy differences A2-A0 in coherent-reliable and coherent-adversarial, preserving seed stratification; no threshold fitted
frozen_design.reference_mechanism: Yggdrasil PR #17 head f0bd57e7ae5f592b2e387a9d3fc1dcba828fb0c7; Python project_consumer imported directly
frozen_design.evaluator_access: No generated heldout truth/errors before prereg freeze, implementation hash identity and CKB run authorization

metrics: accuracy for each arm per cohort and seed
number of retained choices when coherent and majority

classification_rules.supported: On 3072 exactly fixed cases, pooled A2-A0 accuracy on coherent-reliable >=+0.10 AND pooled A2-A0 accuracy on coherent-adversarial <=-0.20; report this as evidence of synthetic coherent-corruption weakness, NOT external capability
classification_rules.mixed: No invalid condition and exactly one of the two supported directional thresholds holds
classification_rules.negative: No invalid condition, neither supported nor mixed; preserve all outcomes without retuning
classification_rules.invalid: Changed case counts/seeds/cohorts/arms, generator/code identity drift, invalid field shape, any capacity/budget/external-data leakage, hidden learner, or evaluation before CKB freeze
